tools.title: Canva

servers.name: Canva MCP server
servers.capabilities: Generate, edit, search, export and comment on designs, upload assets; resize, autofill and brand templates need Canva Pro or above.

servers.name: Canva Dev MCP server
servers.capabilities: Development help for building Canva apps and integrations, using canva.dev documentation.
servers.access: Read operations described; no enforced read-only mode is recorded.

tools.notes: The developer docs give https://api.canva.com/connect/v1/mcp and OAuth with a Developer Portal app; Canva's registry entry lists https://mcp.canva.com/mcp for personal assistants, but its help page could not be opened (HTTP 403) to confirm. The transport is not named.

tools.title: Figma
tools.summary: Collaborative interface design and prototyping tool.

servers.name: Figma MCP server (remote)
servers.capabilities: Reads design context, variables and components from Figma files and can write to the canvas.
servers.access: Design context of the Figma nodes the client points to; can create new designs and files. Editing existing files is not described.
servers.scopes: Sign in with the Figma account and allow access in the client; only clients in Figma's MCP catalog can connect. The page names no scope list.

servers.name: Figma MCP server (desktop)
servers.capabilities: Local server run by the Figma desktop app (Dev Mode); reads design context of open files, no canvas writes.
servers.access: Read operations described; no enforced read-only mode is recorded.

tools.notes: Only clients listed in Figma's MCP catalog can connect to the remote server; Starter plan and View/Collab seats are limited to 6 tool calls per month. The desktop server needs the Figma desktop app and a Dev or Full seat on a paid plan.

tools.title: Miro
tools.summary: Online whiteboard for diagrams, workshops and visual collaboration.

servers.name: Miro MCP Server
servers.capabilities: Read board content as context for code and create diagrams and visualizations on boards.

tools.notes: Works on all Miro plans including free; access is limited to the team chosen during OAuth. The docs do not name the transport. Miro's own registry entry labels the server Beta.

tools.title: Penpot

servers.name: Penpot MCP server (local)
servers.capabilities: Same tools, run locally with its plugin server; clients connect to http://localhost:4401/mcp.

tools.notes: Both need a Penpot file open in an active browser tab with the MCP plugin connected. The hosted key (userToken query parameter, from Your account > Integrations > MCP Server) expires and is shown once; self-hosted instances use their own domain. The transport of the hosted endpoint is not named in the help page. Old repo penpot/penpot-mcp is archived. Penpot's hosted server puts a personal key in the URL, so it cannot be written to a shared file and is not listed. Start it with `npx -y @penpot/mcp@latest`; the endpoint answers while it runs.

tools.title: Storybook
tools.summary: Workshop for building, documenting and testing UI components in isolation.

servers.name: Storybook MCP addon
servers.capabilities: Runs an MCP server inside the Storybook dev server: component docs (from the components manifest), development and testing toolsets.
servers.access: Read or write, depending on the server configuration, the tools enabled or the consent given.

tools.notes: Installed as an addon (the command adds it to the project), then the agent connects to http://localhost:6006/mcp while Storybook runs; the port may differ. The docs toolset needs a supported framework (React, angular-vite, vue3-vite). Code moved from storybookjs/mcp (archived) into the storybook monorepo in v10.6. Add it with `npx storybook add @storybook/addon-mcp`; the endpoint answers while Storybook runs.
